summary: Reviewers can remove a single access, you can act on drift directly, and the drift mail follows your schedule.

new.title: Remove one access in a review
new.text: In a department access review, tick the access a person no longer needs and choose Remove. Only that access is staged for removal; the account keeps the rest.

new.title: Unanswered reviews can request removal
new.text: A review rule can now request removal for people still undecided after the reminders. A PIM administrator approves or denies each request; by default undecided people keep access.

new.title: Delete, Keep or Ignore on Drift
new.text: On the Drift page, an extra item can be deleted after commit, kept so PIM Manager manages it, or ignored in one click. Ignored items can be re-added.

new.title: Drift mail on your schedule
new.text: The drift alert mail now goes out monthly by default. A SuperAdmin can change it to daily, weekly or quarterly on the Drift page.

new.title: Access reviews are per department only
new.text: A group's review cycle no longer creates a Microsoft Entra access review per group. Reviews created earlier stay in Entra ID until you remove them.
